## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK025 Are browser capability dependencies documented as live feature checks rather than browser-name assumptions? [Dependency, Contract §Capability Matrix]
- [x] CHK026 Are existing web shell accessibility patterns available as implementation precedent for focus, live status, mobile navigation, and progress UI? [Dependency, Codebase: web/src/components/layout, web/src/components/symbol/SourcePane.tsx, web/src/tests/app-shell.test.tsx]

## Research Notes

- Keyboard and focus coverage is grounded in WCAG 2.2 keyboard, focus order, focus visible, dragging movements, and status-message criteria.
- Long-operation announcements are grounded in WAI ARIA status/live-region and progress-bar techniques.
- Reduced-motion coverage is grounded in the `prefers-reduced-motion` media feature.
- Explicit picker activation remains grounded in File System Access `showDirectoryPicker()` transient user activation requirements.
